objective: Test whether forced inventory and collateral stress in Binance COIN-M inverse perpetuals predicts executable single-leg USD-M BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT returns after actual BBO, latency, fees and impact.

economic_logic.asymmetry: In an inverse coin-margined long, a downside move can combine position loss with a decline in the USD value of collateral. The resulting margin demand can make aggressive COIN-M selling and quote depletion lead USD-M price adjustment. This downside mechanism is tested separately from symmetric information flow.
economic_logic.smc_ict_translation: A liquidity run requires persistent COIN-M aggressive flow and BBO depletion followed by incomplete USD-M response. A sweep/rejection requires the COIN-M impulse to decay and USD-M executable basis to begin reverting. No historical candle is retroactively labelled.
economic_logic.execution: Only one Binance USD-M position is opened. COIN-M is an observed signal market, never a simultaneous hedge.

families.coinm_downside_collateral_cascade: COIN-M downside price and aggressive-flow shock with local quote depletion while USD-M has incompletely responded; short USD-M.
families.coinm_flow_first_propagation: Either-direction COIN-M aggressive-flow and mid-price impulse precedes the same-direction USD-M adjustment.
families.usdm_overreaction_fade: USD-M executable move exceeds the contemporaneous COIN-M response while COIN-M flow does not confirm; fade USD-M toward cross-contract fair value.
families.simultaneous_basis_snapback: Both contracts move together, but executable COIN-M versus USD-M basis becomes extreme and begins to contract; trade USD-M toward basis normalization.

source_contract.integrity: Every ZIP must match its adjacent official .CHECKSUM; source replacement creates a new dataset revision.
source_contract.fail_closed: If official BBO history is unavailable for either contract type, no strategy PnL is computed and no midpoint or kline fill substitute is allowed.

information_availability.signal_events: Only aggregate trades and BBO events timestamped at or before the completed observation bucket are used.
information_availability.bucket: Events are grouped into non-overlapping 100ms, 500ms or 1s exchange-time buckets; a bucket becomes available only at its end.
information_availability.entry: First actual USD-M BBO event at or after bucket end plus registered combined data/order latency.
information_availability.same_timestamp: When cross-contract event order is not identifiable, strategy-adverse ordering is used.
information_availability.funding_collision: Entries whose maximum hold can cross a USD-M funding settlement are blocked.

time_splits.development_days: remaining first UTC day of every month in 2022 and 2023
time_splits.selection_days: first UTC day of every month in 2024, physically unopened until development pass
time_splits.confirmation_days: first UTC day of every month in 2025, physically unopened until one frozen 2024 primary

portfolio_and_costs.fills: Observed executable USD-M bid/ask plus adverse quantity impact; every entered trade must exit.
portfolio_and_costs.ambiguous_ordering: Protective stop before convergence or profit exit.
portfolio_and_costs.drawdown: Executable mark-to-liquidation value throughout each position and closed account path.

promotion.requirement_after_sample_confirmation: Full independently registered official or institutional tick dataset covering every operable day, followed by the same frozen target test.
promotion.target_test: Net external-cashflow-adjusted geometric daily NAV return >=0.01 only after all rules and full-day data are fixed.

prohibitions: No kline midpoint fills when BBO is unavailable.
No target-return, leverage, fee or latency fitting.
No 2024 or 2025 URL request before the preceding frozen gate.
No paper, testnet or live orders.
